{{Top|ca|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Orthodontia''' was the study and practice of medicine relating to [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Healthy teeth">{{TORcite|type=message|Healthy teeth|Doc}}</ref> the [[xenopathologist]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], also known as Doc, practiced orthodontia for a brief [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Healthy teeth" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I realized when I was in the refresher later that I never told you about my stint practicing orthodontia on Rodia.|Part of Doc's message|<ref name="Healthy teeth" />}}
Orthodontia is first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in the message "Healthy teeth" from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's companion character Doc. Only [[Gender/Legends|female]] players who are pursuing a romance with Doc will receive the message.<ref name="Healthy teeth" />
